Our showcase

Our vendors are the attraction

Nobody crosses town for an empty stage. Families come for the trompo you can see from the corner, the just-cut vegetables, and the artisan they already know by name. This is what awaits you at every Prestige event:

The trompo & the flat-top

The heart of the kermés: taqueros cooking everything to order, right in front of you, with the trompo spinning since early morning and the flat-top full of warm tortillas.

Crowd favoritesTacos al pastor · quesabirrias · carne asada tacos · mulitas

Antojitos like home

Family booths where the recipe comes from grandma: antojitos, homemade salsas, and that comal aroma you can smell a block away.

Crowd favoritesElotes · quesadillas · sopes · aguas frescas

Food trucks for everyone

When the sun goes down, the trucks light up and the tables fill up. Everyone orders their own and everything gets shared: that’s how families have dinner at a Prestige event.

Crowd favoritesOutdoor dinner · kid-friendly options · desserts on wheels

Straight from the grower

The farmers market as it should be: seasonal fruits and vegetables, harvested close to home, sold by the same people who plant and pick them.

Crowd favoritesSeasonal vegetables · fresh fruit · local farm products

Handmade, made here

Ceramics, wood, textiles and one-of-a-kind pieces from local artisans. You buy directly from the maker — and you take the story home with the piece.

Crowd favoritesCeramics · wood · textiles · unique gifts

Neighborhood businesses

Southern Utah entrepreneurs growing booth by booth: pan dulce, homemade products, local services and new ideas born in the community.

Crowd favoritesPan dulce · homemade products · new businesses getting started

Frequently asked questions

What everyone asks us

Can’t find your answer? Email us at prestigeeventmg@gmail.com

What services does Prestige Event Management Group offer?+
We organize festivals, markets, community events and vendor opportunities across Southern Utah. We offer professional event planning, vendor applications, event information, sponsorship opportunities and support for vendors and exhibitors.
How do I apply to become a vendor?+
Complete the online application, upload all required documents and submit it. Once your application is reviewed and approved, you’ll receive payment instructions and additional event information by email. You can start by writing to us at prestigeeventmg@gmail.com — or use the contact form below.
What documents do vendors need?+
Depending on the event, you may be asked for:
  • Business License
  • Sales Tax License
  • Health Department Permit (if applicable)
  • Food Handler Permit
  • Food Manager Certification (if applicable)
  • Liability Insurance
  • Any other document required by the event
Can I sell food at the events?+
Yes — food is the star of our events. Food booths and food trucks need their health permits up to date: Health Department Permit, Food Handler Permit and, if applicable, Food Manager Certification, plus their business license and insurance.
I’m a local business just getting started — can I take part?+
Absolutely! Our markets are exactly where community businesses take their first steps. Apply with your documents in order and tell us what you sell: we look for variety so every event feels different.
How do I secure my booth space?+
Apply first. Once your application is approved, payment secures your space, and Prestige sends the payment instructions by email. The “Secure Your Space” button on this page is left open for now, ready to connect to Prestige’s official payment link when it’s provided.
